candidate.title: SLAF-Seq
candidate.scope: The single Illumina SLAF-Seq schematic, captioned Specific locus amplified fragment sequencing (SLAF-seq) for large scale genotyping, from Genome to terminal DNA. Its seven process captions depict a MseI/adaptor/AluI implementation supported by the common-carp example in Sun et al. (PMID 23527008); this does not impose the same enzymes on all SLAF-seq designs. ddRADseq is a catalogue comparison, and the listed kit and application assays are not alternative targets. The genomic highlight and restriction-site ticks are descriptive; repeated fragment glyphs form a mixed population rather than independent workflow branches. The graph preserves the drawn route and stops at DNA. Paper-only pre-design, size selection, sequencing and analysis are explanatory context, not extra graph operations.
